Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: forecasting, uncertainty quantification, power generation. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
